name: 16 - API - Reschedule Appointment - Schedule Guarded V3

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS appointment_id,
        $2::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $3::TEXT AS mobile,
        $4::DATE AS new_target_date,
        $5::TIME AS new_start_time
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone
    FROM clinics c
    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
    WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY c.id
    LIMIT 1
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS patient_id,
        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile
    FROM patients p
    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = p.clinic_id
    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON p.mobile = r.mobile
    ORDER BY p.id
    LIMIT 1
),

appointment_context AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,
        a.starts_at AS old_starts_at,
        a.ends_at AS old_ends_at,
        a.status,
        a.visit_reason,
        a.google_calendar_event_id,

        c.clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        p.patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.buffer_minutes,

        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        r.new_target_date,
        r.new_start_time

    FROM appointments a

    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patient_context p
        ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.appointment_id = a.id
),

target_slot AS (
    SELECT
        ac.*,

        slot.slot_start_local
            AT TIME ZONE ac.timezone
            AS new_starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + make_interval(mins => ac.duration_minutes)
        ) AT TIME ZONE ac.timezone
            AS new_ends_at

    FROM appointment_context ac

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = ac.doctor_id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE
       AND ds.weekday =
            EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM ac.new_target_date)::INTEGER
       AND (
            ds.valid_from IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_from <= ac.new_target_date
       )
       AND (
            ds.valid_to IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_to >= ac.new_target_date
       )

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        ac.new_target_date + ds.start_time,

        ac.new_target_date
            + ds.end_time
            - make_interval(mins => ac.duration_minutes),

        make_interval(
            mins => ac.duration_minutes + ac.buffer_minutes
        )
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)

    WHERE slot.slot_start_local =
          ac.new_target_date + ac.new_start_time

    LIMIT 1
),

slot_conflict AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM appointments existing

        INNER JOIN target_slot target
            ON target.doctor_id = existing.doctor_id

        WHERE existing.id <> target.appointment_id

          AND existing.status IN (
              'pending',
              'confirmed'
          )

          AND existing.starts_at < target.new_ends_at
          AND existing.ends_at > target.new_starts_at
    ) AS has_conflict
),

schedule_exception_conflict AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM schedule_exceptions se

        INNER JOIN target_slot target
            ON target.doctor_id = se.doctor_id

        WHERE se.is_active = TRUE
          AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

          AND se.starts_at < target.new_ends_at
          AND se.ends_at > target.new_starts_at
    ) AS is_blocked
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context)
             NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN FALSE
        WHEN (SELECT old_ends_at FROM appointment_context) <= NOW() THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_slot) THEN FALSE
        WHEN (SELECT new_starts_at FROM target_slot) <= NOW() THEN FALSE
        WHEN (
            SELECT old_starts_at = new_starts_at
            FROM target_slot
        ) THEN FALSE
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT is_blocked FROM schedule_exception_conflict),
            FALSE
        ) THEN FALSE
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT has_conflict FROM slot_conflict),
            FALSE
        ) THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS ready_to_reschedule,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN 'patient_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_context)
            THEN 'appointment_not_found'
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context)
             NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
            THEN 'appointment_not_reschedulable'
        WHEN (SELECT old_ends_at FROM appointment_context) <= NOW()
            THEN 'appointment_in_past'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_slot)
            THEN 'invalid_target_slot'
        WHEN (SELECT new_starts_at FROM target_slot) <= NOW()
            THEN 'target_time_in_past'
        WHEN (
            SELECT old_starts_at = new_starts_at
            FROM target_slot
        )
            THEN 'same_appointment_time'
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT is_blocked FROM schedule_exception_conflict),
            FALSE
        )
            THEN 'target_time_blocked'
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT has_conflict FROM slot_conflict),
            FALSE
        )
            THEN 'slot_unavailable'
        ELSE 'can_reschedule'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN 'بیماری با این شماره موبایل در کلینیک پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_context)
            THEN 'این نوبت برای بیمار موردنظر پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context)
             NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
            THEN 'وضعیت فعلی نوبت اجازه جابه‌جایی خودکار را نمی‌دهد.'
        WHEN (SELECT old_ends_at FROM appointment_context) <= NOW()
            THEN 'نوبت مربوط به گذشته است و قابل جابه‌جایی نیست.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_slot)
            THEN 'زمان جدید با برنامه کاری پزشک و فاصله زمانی نوبت‌ها تطابق ندارد.'
        WHEN (SELECT new_starts_at FROM target_slot) <= NOW()
            THEN 'زمان جدید باید مربوط به آینده باشد.'
        WHEN (
            SELECT old_starts_at = new_starts_at
            FROM target_slot
        )
            THEN 'زمان جدید با زمان فعلی نوبت یکسان است.'
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT is_blocked FROM schedule_exception_conflict),
            FALSE
        )
            THEN 'زمان جدید در برنامه پزشک مسدود شده است.'
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT has_conflict FROM slot_conflict),
            FALSE
        )
            THEN 'زمان انتخاب‌شده دیگر در دسترس نیست.'
        ELSE 'نوبت آماده جابه‌جایی است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            old_starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS old_appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            new_starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM target_slot
    ) AS new_appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT google_calendar_event_id
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS google_calendar_event_id

FROM request_data;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS appointment_id,
        $2::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $3::TEXT AS mobile,
        $4::DATE AS new_target_date,
        $5::TIME AS new_start_time,
        $6::TEXT AS reschedule_reason
),

target_context AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,

        a.starts_at AS old_starts_at,
        a.ends_at AS old_ends_at,
        a.google_calendar_event_id AS old_calendar_event_id,

        c.timezone,

        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.buffer_minutes,

        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        slot.slot_start_local
            AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
            AS new_starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + make_interval(mins => s.duration_minutes)
        ) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
            AS new_ends_at,

        r.reschedule_reason

    FROM request_data r

    INNER JOIN appointments a
        ON a.id = r.appointment_id
       AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
       AND a.ends_at > NOW()

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.id = a.clinic_id
       AND c.name = r.clinic_name
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN patients p
        ON p.id = a.patient_id
       AND p.mobile = r.mobile

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE
       AND ds.weekday =
            EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM r.new_target_date)::INTEGER
       AND (
            ds.valid_from IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_from <= r.new_target_date
       )
       AND (
            ds.valid_to IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_to >= r.new_target_date
       )

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        r.new_target_date + ds.start_time,

        r.new_target_date
            + ds.end_time
            - make_interval(mins => s.duration_minutes),

        make_interval(
            mins => s.duration_minutes + d.buffer_minutes
        )
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)

    WHERE slot.slot_start_local =
          r.new_target_date + r.new_start_time

      AND (
            slot.slot_start_local
                AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
      ) > NOW()

    LIMIT 1
),

updated_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments a

    SET
        starts_at = target.new_starts_at,
        ends_at = target.new_ends_at,

        reschedule_count =
            COALESCE(a.reschedule_count, 0) + 1,

        rescheduled_at = NOW(),
        last_reschedule_reason = target.reschedule_reason,

        google_calendar_event_id = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM target_context target

    WHERE a.id = target.appointment_id

      AND target.new_starts_at <> target.old_starts_at

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointments existing

          WHERE existing.doctor_id = target.doctor_id
            AND existing.id <> target.appointment_id

            AND existing.status IN (
                'pending',
                'confirmed'
            )

            AND existing.starts_at < target.new_ends_at
            AND existing.ends_at > target.new_starts_at
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM schedule_exceptions se

          WHERE se.doctor_id = target.doctor_id
            AND se.is_active = TRUE
            AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

            AND se.starts_at < target.new_ends_at
            AND se.ends_at > target.new_starts_at
      )

    RETURNING
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,

        target.old_starts_at,
        target.old_ends_at,

        a.starts_at AS new_starts_at,
        a.ends_at AS new_ends_at,

        target.old_calendar_event_id,
        target.patient_name,
        target.mobile,
        target.doctor_name,
        target.service_name,
        target.timezone,
        target.reschedule_reason,

        a.status,
        a.reschedule_count,
        a.rescheduled_at
),

history_record AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_reschedule_history (
        appointment_id,
        old_starts_at,
        old_ends_at,
        new_starts_at,
        new_ends_at,
        reason,
        source
    )

    SELECT
        appointment_id,
        old_starts_at,
        old_ends_at,
        new_starts_at,
        new_ends_at,
        reschedule_reason,
        'assistant'

    FROM updated_appointment

    RETURNING id AS history_id
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'rescheduled' AS result,
    'نوبت با موفقیت جابه‌جا شد.' AS message,

    ua.appointment_id,
    ua.patient_name,
    ua.mobile,
    ua.doctor_name,
    ua.service_name,

    TO_CHAR(
        ua.old_starts_at AT TIME ZONE ua.timezone,
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
    ) AS old_appointment_start,

    TO_CHAR(
        ua.new_starts_at AT TIME ZONE ua.timezone,
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
    ) AS new_appointment_start,

    ua.new_starts_at,
    ua.new_ends_at,

    ua.status,
    ua.reschedule_count,
    ua.rescheduled_at,
    ua.reschedule_reason,

    ua.old_calendar_event_id,

    (
        SELECT history_id
        FROM history_record
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reschedule_history_id

FROM updated_appointment ua

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE AS success,
    'reschedule_conflict' AS result,
    'زمان انتخاب‌شده در فاصله بررسی تا ثبت تغییر کرده است. زمان‌های آزاد را دوباره بررسی کنید.' AS message,

    NULL::BIGINT AS appointment_id,
    NULL::TEXT AS patient_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS mobile,
    NULL::TEXT AS doctor_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS service_name,

    NULL::TEXT AS old_appointment_start,
    NULL::TEXT AS new_appointment_start,

    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS new_starts_at,
    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS new_ends_at,

    NULL::TEXT AS status,
    NULL::INTEGER AS reschedule_count,
    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS rescheduled_at,
    NULL::TEXT AS reschedule_reason,

    NULL::TEXT AS old_calendar_event_id,
    NULL::BIGINT AS reschedule_history_id

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM updated_appointment
);

SET
    google_calendar_event_id = $1,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING
    id AS appointment_id,
    google_calendar_event_id;

parameters.content:
## نسخه Schedule Guarded V3

این نسخه هنگام بررسی و ثبت زمان جدید، جدول `schedule_exceptions` را نیز کنترل می‌کند.

ابتدا Workflow شماره 17 را فقط یک‌بار اجرا کن.

زمان جدید را از خروجی Workflow شماره 11 نسخه Schedule Guarded V2 انتخاب کن.
